Out of scope: organisation, marketing events and ads, merchant-partner and facility usage counts, accreditation counts (267 marketers, 20 merchants, 43 facilities), 3,405 marketing leads, satisfaction survey (88%/56%), budget utilisation, return on marketing expense, ISO, governance, FOI requests, staff directory. All amounts and both dates already in the data (6 terms, 2 events). No statistics. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

Added one event (in force 18 Jan 2024). Amounts restate existing terms. No statistics. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

Amounts are already terms (from the laws, with these conditions in their notes) and the stay rule is an event. The rest of the republication is general immigration regulation. No statistics. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

Law 102/2017 (74 pp.), fifth amendment to Law 23/2007 with full republication: fund route lowered to EUR 350k (Portuguese funds, 5-year maturity, 60% in Portuguese companies) and new company-capital route (EUR 350k with 5 jobs); ARI renewed for two-year periods (art. 90-A(2)); other changes on students, researchers, entrepreneurs, Blue Card. Both ARI amounts are already terms and the change is an event; the rest of the republication restates earlier ARI amounts or concerns other permits. No statistics. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).

Law 63/2015 (2 pp.), third amendment to Law 23/2007: art. 3(1)(d) adds subalíneas iv-vii (EUR 350k rehabilitation, EUR 350k research, EUR 250k culture, EUR 500k SME funds) and cuts job creation to 10; art. 3(2)-(3) allow 20% lower amounts for ii-vi in low-density NUTS III areas; decision deadlines for all permits (90/60 days, general, not ARI-specific); adult student children as ARI family members; repeals art. 90-A(3) (regulation by ministerial order); in force the day after 30 Jun 2015. No statistics. Rules restated from other sources are now recorded from this document too (decision 8).
